title: Vintage Hero Sandwich Comic Lot Issues 1 & 2, Slave Labor 1987
descriptionText:
The product is a vintage comic lot of issues 1 and 2 of the Hero Sandwich series, published by Slave Labor Graphics in 1987. The comics fall under the genre of superheroes and are traditional US comics. This collectible item appeals to fans of comic books and graphic novels looking to add rare and unique pieces to their collection.

Vintage Hero Sandwich comic lot published by Slave Labor Graphics
Includes the first two issues of the series
Lot includes
Hero Sandwich No 1
Hero Sandwich No 2
Classic late 1980s indie comic with distinctive Slave Labor style
Fun obscure title that appeals to indie comic collectors
You will receive the exact two comics shown in the photos
